keyframes.source: “the baker wraps a warm loaf in paper”
keyframes.state: The first loaf is enclosed in one cream paper sheet on the counter beneath the baker’s hands. The second loaf remains unwrapped beside the remaining paper sheet.
The neighbour now holds the first paper-wrapped loaf. Only the second, unwrapped loaf and its paper sheet remain on the counter.

keyframes.source: “then wraps the second loaf for the parent”
keyframes.state: The second loaf is enclosed in the remaining paper sheet on the counter beneath the baker’s hands, opposite the parent. The neighbour still holds the first wrapped loaf.

keyframes.source: “The baker’s tired face brightens at their grateful smiles.”
keyframes.state: The neighbour and parent have grateful smiles directed toward the baker. The baker’s tired face is now bright with pleasure, eyes toward them; the two wrapped loaves remain in their previous positions.

first: An eye-height, fixed wide diagonal view from the rear customer-side corner of the modest bakery toward its front wall: cream plaster, honey-coloured timber, and worn stone flooring, with clean, comfortably used surfaces. The blue glazed front door is far left, its shop-name sign mounted at adult chest height; the large clear front window is far right. The wooden workbench is far right with its working edge toward the camera and the flour bowl resting at its far-right end. The dark metal oven stands middle right against the right wall, and the wire cooling rack stands near right. The wooden shop counter runs from near to far at middle left. The baker stands behind the counter, facing the neighbour and parent on its customer side, with a tired expression and hands beside the first loaf. The child stands beside the parent. Two unwrapped, broad oval loaves with honey-gold crusts and three diagonal expansion marks each rest on the counter: the first on a flat cream wrapping-paper sheet directly before the baker and opposite the neighbour, the second beside a separate flat cream wrapping-paper sheet opposite the parent.
